title: Hypnos model record
description: One population PK/PD model of one drug for one purpose. The unit of curation.

kernel.description: Binding to the pure-Python reference kernel that instantiates this model from covariates.

function.description: registry key of the covariate->parameters function

covariate_model.description: Verbatim published equation, for human verification and export.

lbm_equation.description: Named lean-body-mass / fat-free-mass equation (choice has documented failure modes).

crcl_ml_min.description: Creatinine-clearance range the model was fit across (renal-function dimension, v0.5 §B4). Absent => the model claims no renal-impairment standing.

albumin_g_dl.description: Serum-albumin range the model was fit across (free-fraction dimension, v0.5 §B3/§B4).

ejection_fraction_pct.description: Cardiac-output / ejection-fraction range the model was fit across (v0.5 §B4).

pma_weeks.description: Post-menstrual-age range (weeks) the model was fit across (v0.8 §4). PMA = gestational + postnatal age; the maturation clock, NOT chronological age. Absent => no neonatal/infant standing.

postnatal_age_days.description: Postnatal-age range (days) the model was fit across (v0.8 §4).

gestational_age_weeks.description: Gestational-age range (weeks) at birth (v0.8 §4); with postnatal age it composes PMA.

bche_phenotype.description: DECLARED-only BCHE phenotype dimension (v0.9 §4). Categorical; a genotype is never inferred, only declared.

mh_susceptibility.description: DECLARED-only malignant-hyperthermia susceptibility (v0.9 §4); a susceptibility, never a kinetic dimension.

organ_tolerance.description: Cited mechanistic standing in an organ-failure state the model was NOT fit in (e.g. remifentanil's esterase clearance is hepatic/renal-independent). Grants envelope standing on that axis without a refitted model (v0.5 §B3). Absent => no standing; an organ-impaired patient is greyed + Tier-D.

basis.description: The cited mechanistic reason for standing.

caveat.description: A residual caveat even given standing (e.g. renal accumulation of an active metabolite).

covariate_sensitivity_status.description: Rollup of how the model's derived-covariate equations are curated; drives the v0.7 covariate-equation divergence view + the UI badge (v0.7 spec §3.1/§5). 'none' => scales on raw covariates only; 'declared' => names its derived-input equations; 'computed' is caller-side (a covariate-value distribution was supplied) and never appears in the dataset.

pharmacogenomic_modifiers.description: Cited, opt-in, Tier-D KINETIC modifiers a declared genotype/phenotype applies to this model (v0.9 §4). A modifier scales a prediction; it is NEVER a susceptibility flag (those carry no number).

pharmacogenomic_safety_flags.description: Genotype-conferred adverse-event SUSCEPTIBILITIES rendered as avoidance/awareness flags (v0.9 §4). A flag forbids a trigger; it carries NO kinetic effect (no adjustment) — the schema separation makes the category error impossible.

toxicity_thresholds.description: Systemic-toxicity threshold RANGES for a local anesthetic (v0.6 spec §3.3). ALWAYS a range with low<high and an explicit basis — never a single 'toxic at X' line. The schema forbids a single-value threshold by construction (both range bounds are required, non-null).

variability_status.description: Rollup of how much of the NLME random-effects structure is curated; drives band eligibility (v0.2 spec §5).

uncertainty_status.description: Rollup of curated ESTIMATION uncertainty (distinct from variability_status); drives confidence-band eligibility + the UI badge (v0.3 spec §5). 'none' => no confidence band drawn (never-synthesize).

external_validation.description: Hypnos-COMPUTED Varvel metrics against open data, reproducible and distinct from the human-curated publisher-reported predictive_performance (v0.4 spec §4.1).

validation_status.description: Rollup of external-validation coverage; UI badge + tier-falsification input (v0.4 spec §4.3).

reversal_mechanism.description: Links a reversal agent to the agonist model(s) it acts on, by mechanism (v0.5 §A2/§A3). A reversal agent has no interesting solo trajectory; antagonism is an INTERACTION. encapsulation (sugammadex, PK-level binding) | competitive_receptor (naloxone/flumazenil, PD-level potency shift) | enzyme_inhibition (neostigmine, indirect, with a hard ceiling). NEVER computes a reversal dose (§A6).

targets.description: The agonist model id(s) this agent reverses — validated to resolve to existing records.

binding.description: encapsulation kinetics; an instantaneous-1:1 `approximation` is labeled as a simplification (§A5).

antagonism.description: competitive_receptor potency: apparent Ce50 -> Ce50*(1 + C_antag/ki).

indirect.description: enzyme_inhibition (neostigmine): the ceiling and depth floor are the safety content, not free parameters.

developmental_model.description: An adult model's developmental (pediatric/neonatal) extrapolation by allometric size and, where curated, PMA-driven clearance maturation (v0.8 §4). Tier-D by construction, opt-in only, always cited and warned — NEVER a silent reparameterization. A model actually fitted in children is a DIFFERENT record (evidence), not this annotation.

extrapolation_basis.description: allometry_only carries the over-dose caveat (un-modeled maturation OVER-states neonatal clearance); allometry_plus_maturation composes both; fitted_pediatric labels a model that earned its tier in children (evidence).

evidence_tier.description: Extrapolation defaults to D; a fitted-in-children model is a different record.

applied_by_default.description: MUST be false for an extrapolation — never silently reparameterizes an adult model (opt-in only).

size_model.description: Theory-based allometric size scaling (v0.8 §3): clearance ∝ weight^cl_exponent (¾ by default), volume ∝ weight^v_exponent (1.0), relative to a reference individual.

reference_weight_kg.description: The reference individual the adult parameters are stated at (commonly 70 kg).

exponent_basis.description: theory_fixed (West/Brown allometry) or fitted (needs an SE home; v0.7 Trap 5).

size_descriptor.description: Optional: resolves to a v0.7 covariate-equation id (e.g. 'ffm:al_sallami_2015') for the pediatric-valid body-size descriptor.

maturation_model.description: PMA-driven clearance maturation (v0.8 §3) — the neonatal/infant load-bearing fact. The Anderson–Holford sigmoid MF(PMA) = PMA^Hill / (TM50^Hill + PMA^Hill). The driver MUST be a PMA-class clock, never chronological age (v0.8 §4 Trap 1).

hill.description: Hill coefficient of the maturation sigmoid.

driver.description: The age clock; PMA only (the cardinal pediatric trap is using chronological age).

affected_parameter.description: The cleared parameter the MF multiplies (e.g. 'Cl'). A single MF on a multi-pathway clearance is a labeled simplification (Trap 4).

pharmacogenomic_modifier.description: A KINETIC pharmacogenomic modifier (v0.9 §4): a declared genotype/phenotype that scales a drug's disposition. Opt-in, Tier-D by construction, substrate-scoped, always cited. It scales a prediction — it MUST NOT carry trigger_agents (that would be a susceptibility, a different object).

phenotype_basis.description: The lossy genotype→phenotype mapping basis (e.g. 'dibucaine number < 30'); the translation source the verifier confirms (Trap 1).

substrate_scope.description: The drugs/classes the gene actually acts on (e.g. succinylcholine, mivacurium, ester_la). Mandatory; validated so a genetic effect never leaks to a non-substrate drug (Trap 4).

value.description: Illustrative directional magnitude — the phenotype, not a precise CL (the caveat is mandatory).

direction.description: The forward direction the modifier moves the prediction (v0.9 Trap 5; never assumed from 'PM = less drug').

evidence_tier.description: D unless backed by a linked fitted-by-genotype model.

pharmacogenomic_safety_flag.description: A pharmacogenomic SUSCEPTIBILITY rendered as an avoidance/awareness flag (v0.9 §4). It forbids a trigger; it carries NO kinetic effect. It MUST NOT carry an `adjustment` — the schema separation makes the MH-as-clearance-change category error impossible (Trap 2).

trigger_agents.description: The agents/classes to AVOID (e.g. volatiles, succinylcholine).

action.description: The avoidance/awareness action — explicitly NOT a dose adjustment.

kind.description: avoidance (a hard contraindication, e.g. MH) vs awareness (expect a prolonged effect, e.g. atypical BCHE).

evidence_tier.description: On the gene–trigger/gene–phenotype link; says nothing about a (non-existent) kinetic tier.

covariate_model.description: Which named auxiliary body-size/composition equations this model is DERIVED with (v0.7 spec §3.1). Promotes and structures the lone covariates.lbm_equation string into a validated binding: each derived covariate the model consumes names the exact published equation (by id into dataset/covariate_equations/), what it scales, and whether it is the authors' verbatim choice. Silent substitution of one of these equations is the field's best-documented 'same model, different answer' divergence.

equation.description: Resolves to a dataset/covariate_equations/ record id (checked by hypnos validate).

used_for.description: Which structural parameter symbols scale on this derived quantity (each must resolve to a real parameter; drives the §7 sensitivity).

verbatim.description: true => the model's authors used exactly this equation; false => a documented, cited substitution (only ever shown in the divergence view, never as the model's own prediction).

parameter_variability.description: Between-subject (and optional inter-occasion) variability for ONE structural parameter (v0.2 spec §3.1). Has its own tier and extraction, independent of the point-estimate tier.

bsv.description: Between-subject variability on the eta (log) scale by default.

omega2.description: CANONICAL: variance on the eta scale (the NONMEM $OMEGA diagonal entry).

distribution.description: exponential (log-normal) BSV unless stated; additive BSV puts omega2 on the natural scale.

cv_percent.description: OPTIONAL human-readable convenience; checked-consistent with omega2 (spec §4 Trap 1).

shrinkage_percent.description: eta-shrinkage if the source reports it (interpretation caveat, spec §4 Trap 4).

omega2_se.description: SE on the curated BSV variance ω² — second-order ESTIMATION uncertainty on this v0.2 layer (v0.3 §2.2). RSE on the VARIANCE, not the SD (v0.3 §4 Trap 5).

iov.description: Inter-occasion variability, only when separately published; NEVER folded into bsv (spec §2.3).

residual_error.description: Residual unexplained variability — the Sigma layer (v0.2 spec §3.2). Each term labels its scale (variance vs sd) in the key name, because variance-vs-SD is the most common Sigma transcription error.

sd.description: sigma_add in concentration units (note: SD, not variance).

log.description: Additive error on the natural-log concentration scale (approx. proportional on the natural scale).

omega_block.description: Published off-diagonal Omega (correlated random effects). Present only when the source publishes covariances/correlations (v0.2 spec §3.3).

complete.description: false => only the listed pairs are published; the rest are UNKNOWN, not zero.

estimation_uncertainty.description: Per-θ ESTIMATION uncertainty — the SE/RSE/CI on the estimated typical value (v0.3 spec §2.1). REDUCIBLE (shrinks with more data), and a DIFFERENT number from the BSV in `variability` (irreducible). Lives BESIDE `variability`, never inside it — the schema separation mirrors the conceptual one, so an RSE can never be silently read as a between-subject CV (v0.3 §4 Trap 1).

se.description: CANONICAL: standard error on the estimated `scale`.

scale.description: Mandatory whenever an SE is present — a log-scale SE applied as natural-scale is silently wrong (v0.3 §4 Trap 2).

rse_percent.description: OPTIONAL convenience; checked-consistent with `se` and `value.central` on the declared scale (Trap 2).

ci95.description: OPTIONAL 95% CI; asymptotic unless `method` says otherwise (bootstrap/SIR CIs stored verbatim).

absorption.description: Site-specific systemic absorption for a local anesthetic (v0.6 spec §3.1). The rate of rise of plasma concentration is a curated function of INJECTION SITE — the headline that the mg/kg max-dose tables are unreliable because absorption is site-driven, not milligram-driven.

ka.description: First-order absorption rate constant (1/min); often Tier-C in magnitude even where the `rank` is robust.

rank.description: Systemic-absorption rank (1 = fastest/highest peak). The DIRECTION is curated even where `ka` magnitude is not (v0.6 §3.1).

toxicity_threshold.description: One systemic-toxicity threshold RANGE for one endpoint (v0.6 spec §3.3). The safety-critical block: a range, never a line. `basis` (total vs free plasma) is mandatory because a free-drug threshold compared against a total-drug prediction is silently wrong (v0.6 §4 Trap 1). For a saturable-binding drug on a total_plasma basis, `saturation_caveat` is required (the free fraction rises non-linearly when total is highest — total under-predicts risk exactly when it is greatest; v0.6 §3.2/§4).

endpoint.description: The toxicity endpoint. The clinical warning sequence is cns_first_symptoms (perioral numbness/tinnitus) -> cns_seizure -> cardiovascular (conduction block/arrhythmia/arrest); for the most cardiotoxic agents the CNS-warning margin can be narrow or absent (v0.6 §3.3).

concentration_range.description: The threshold RANGE. Both bounds are required and non-null — a single-value threshold is a schema error by construction (v0.6 §4).

low.description: Lower bound of the published threshold range (low < high enforced by `hypnos validate`).

high.description: Upper bound of the published threshold range.

basis.description: Whether the range is reported on TOTAL or FREE plasma concentration — drives the §3.2 free-fraction caveat and prevents the total-vs-free conversion error (Trap 1).

individual_variability.description: Qualitative: thresholds are person- and rate-of-rise-dependent; usually 'high'.

method_caveat.description: Derivation context (e.g. volunteer slow-infusion study) so the number is never read as context-free (Trap 3 — speed-of-rise dependence).

saturation_caveat.description: REQUIRED when the drug's binding is saturable and `basis` is total_plasma: names the free-fraction under-prediction failure mode (v0.6 §3.2/§4; enforced by `hypnos validate`).

estimate_covariance.description: Published estimate correlation/covariance — the NONMEM $COV output (v0.3 spec §2.3/§3.2). The estimation-layer analog of `omega_block`, but for ESTIMATION covariance, and NEVER merged with the random-effect covariance.

complete.description: false => only listed estimate pairs published; the rest UNKNOWN, not zero (independence assumed only with a recorded caveat).

covariance_step_succeeded.description: NONMEM $COV often fails; record honestly — an absent SE is then MISSING, not zero (v0.3 §4 Trap 4).

external_validation_entry.description: One Hypnos-computed metric set for one model against one open dataset, in one validation mode and cohort stratum (v0.4 spec §4.1).

provenance.description: What makes the metric reproducible — NOT a human PDF verification.

reproducible.description: Distinguishes this computed block from the human-curated predictive_performance.

review_status.description: Curation state. 'unverified' => illustrative/transcribed, no source cross-check; 'pending_human_review' => an AUTOMATED process cross-checked the curated values against a real, cited source and they matched, but NO human has confirmed against the primary PDF (governance: 'Humans verify; LLMs do not promote' — an automated check can populate evidence but never reaches 'verified'); 'verified' => a human confirmed every field against the source; 'contested' => a sourced disagreement is recorded.

source_review.description: Provenance for an AUTOMATED source cross-check that produced the 'pending_human_review' state. It records exactly what was compared, against which fetched source(s), and the outcome — so a human verifier can audit the machine's work and then promote (or contest) it. It NEVER asserts human verification (`human_verified` is always false here).

reviewed_by.description: The automated reviewer (e.g. 'automated source cross-check (Claude Opus)').

method.description: How the comparison was done (e.g. 'fetched the cited open-access source + an independent reproduction; compared each curated parameter numerically').

sources.description: URLs and/or citation ids actually fetched and compared against.

outcome.description: match => every checked value agreed within rounding; partial_match => some confirmed, some not findable; discrepancy => a recorded disagreement (see notes).

notes.description: What matched, what could not be found, any discrepancy detail.

human_verified.description: ALWAYS false for an automated review — the governance line a machine cannot cross.
